annotations.title: One hearing note, ready to post

description: Signed-in Pro or Firm attorneys only. One hearing note from the attorney's own Pro Workspace: the structured record (hearing date, time and purpose; WCLJ; carrier counsel; body parts with their status such as ANCR or PFME; the WCLJ outcome lines as written; awards: periods, AWW, CCP, attorney fee, classification; WCB status; client testified; depositions; adjournment and next date; to-dos with owners and deadlines, with any HIPAA details; documents to file; notes; the attorney's own sections), the narrative exactly as the attorney approved it, and a field-mapping hint for their case-management system (Litify, Clio, MyCase, Filevine, Smokeball, CASEpeer, Needles, PracticePanther or another). The hint names common places, not the attorney's actual fields: match it to what their system shows, show the attorney a preview and ask before writing anything. Never fill a field the note does not have.

target_system.description: Optional. The case-management system, for the mapping hint (default: the one the attorney chose).
